props.name: open
props.description: Shown or not (v-model:open, or a plain :open).

props.name: title
props.description: Lead line — "You have unsaved changes".

props.name: description
props.description: Second line, quieter. Long explanations belong here, not in the title.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. Omit for a bar that is purely text + buttons.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Buttons on the right, in reading order. The LAST one is the primary and
gets the solid treatment unless it says otherwise — the confirming action
sits closest to the edge the thumb and the eye finish on.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Adds a "✕" that emits `dismiss`. For notices, not for decisions.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Tone. `danger` for a destructive pending action; the default stays neutral
because most of these bars are routine and a page edged in red for every
unsaved field trains people to ignore red.

props.name: width
props.description:
How wide the bar runs.

"contained" (the default) keeps it to the width of its own content, up to
a cap, and centres it: a bar carrying six words and two buttons has no
business spanning a 1920px display, and stretching it puts the buttons a
screen away from the field you were editing.

"full" spans the viewport edge to edge — for a cookie notice, which reads
as part of the page frame rather than as a message about one thing on it.
Its CONTENTS are still capped and centred, so the buttons stay beside the
text instead of being flung to the far corner.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description:
Cap for the bar (or, when `width="full"`, for the row inside it). Any CSS
length. Defaults to a comfortable measure for a line of text and two or
three buttons — wider for `full`, whose job is to span the page and whose
contents therefore sit on the page's own measure, not a card's.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the landmark. Falls back to `title`.

props.name: active
props.description: Work is in flight. Going false finishes the line and fades it out.

props.name: value
props.description: Known progress. Unset or null: the length of the work is unknown, and the line sweeps.

props.name: placement
props.description:
Where it lies. `top` and `bottom` are absolute, over the edge of the
nearest positioned ancestor (give the card `relative`), so showing it
moves nothing; `inline` takes its own line in the flow.

props.name: height
props.description: Thickness in px.

props.name: delay
props.description:
Ms to wait before showing. Work that finishes within it never shows the
line at all: a flash of activity for a 90 ms request is noise.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The address. Bind with v-model.

props.name: provider
props.description: Geocoder for suggestions and for the map's reverse lookup.

props.name: tiles
props.description: Tile server handed to the built-in picker.

props.name: only
props.description: Restrict the country list (ISO2). Omit for every country.

props.name: secondLine
props.description: Show the "apartment, suite" line.

props.name: minChars
props.description: Suggestions start after this many characters.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Debounce before a suggestion request goes out.

props.name: language
props.description: Accept-Language for the geocoder.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Mark every part of the address invalid (also set by a surrounding LpFormField's error).

props.name: hideMap
props.description: Hide the map button when picking a point makes no sense.

slots.name: map
slots.type: { point: LatLon | undefined; setPoint: (next: LatLon) => void; tiles: TileSource; }

props.name: live
props.description:
Announce the alert to screen readers when it appears. "assertive"
(role=alert) interrupts and is for something that needs action now,
"polite" (role=status) waits its turn, false reads it in place. By
default only `danger` interrupts: an info or success banner that is part
of the page from the start should not be shouted on load.

props.name: busy
props.description:
Work is under way: the icon becomes LpLoader's spinner (unless `icon` is
given, which then spins instead) and the alert is announced politely.
A loader drawn as a still icon read as a frozen page.

props.name: items
props.description: Flat items, or sections for grouped nav. Forwarded to LpSidebar.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Folded nav groups (v-model:collapsed). Forwarded to LpSidebar.

props.name: autoCollapseAfter
props.description: Fold long navs automatically; 0 disables. Forwarded to LpSidebar.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Active item id (v-model) when not using a custom `isActive`.

props.name: path
props.description:
The current route path. Enables the built-in prefix-match active test and
the derived page title without the host wiring its own `isActive`. Pass
`route.path`. Ignored when a custom `isActive` is provided.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Custom active test (router-driven nav). Overrides `path`/`modelValue`.

props.name: title
props.description: Override the header title. Falls back to the active item's label.

props.name: mobileBreakpoint
props.description: Tailwind breakpoint below which the rail becomes a drawer.

props.name: divider
props.description: Show the brand/header divider in the rail.

props.name: contentClass
props.description: Max content width inside main (Tailwind class), or null to fill.

props.name: fullBleed
props.description:
Full-bleed main: render the page slot directly into main with NO
scroll-area wrapper and NO padding, so the page owns the whole region
(for a canvas / map / graph that fills the viewport and pans internally).

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading skeleton for the nav.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ openMenu: string; skipToContent: string; }> | undefined
props.description: Text overrides: the burger's name and the skip link.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The free text. This is the model — bind with v-model.

props.name: options
props.description: Suggestions. Strings or {value,label,description}.

props.name: filter
props.description:
Filter suggestions client-side against the typed text. Off when the
parent fetches matches itself (server-side) — then pass the already
narrowed `options` and leave this false.

props.name: minChars
props.description: Min chars before the list opens. 0 = open on focus.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Validation RegExp/string for the whole value (see LpInput).

props.name: restrict
props.description: Allowed-character RegExp; hard-blocks other input (see LpInput).

props.name: selected
props.description:
What the current value stands for, shown in the field itself while it is
not being edited: a picked id reads as a person (avatar in place of the
icon, name, muted hint) instead of digits nobody recognises, and nothing
appears or jumps below the field. Focusing it puts the name in the box,
selected, so typing starts a new search; leaving untouched keeps the pick.
When room runs short the hint gives way first; the name stays.

props.name: icon
props.description:
An icon shown while there is no picture, instead of initials. For things
that have no name worth abbreviating (a world, a mod, a file), where two
letters read as noise. `fallback` text still wins when both are given.

props.name: identicon
props.description:
Draw an identicon while there is no picture, instead of initials: a
pattern and colour derived from a string, so accounts that never set an
avatar still look different from each other. `true` derives it from
`alt`; a string is the seed itself (an id outlives a rename). `fallback`
text and `icon` still win when given.

props.name: pixelSize
props.description: Explicit pixel size, wins over `size` — for avatars keyed to a layout.

props.name: shape
props.description: Silhouette: circle for people, soft/square for servers and projects.

props.name: ring
props.description: Draws a hairline ring, for avatars laid over imagery or other avatars.

props.name: menuItems
props.description: Right-click menu (e.g. account quick actions). Consumer-supplied.

props.name: menuTitle
props.description:
Heading of that menu. Defaults to `alt` with the picture beside it, so
the menu says whose avatar it acts on; an empty string drops it.

props.name: menuSubtitle
props.description: A muted line under the menu heading, e.g. a handle or a role.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` is the one that does not disturb a text-sm line it sits on.

props.name: removable
props.description: A ✕ after the content that emits `remove`: a tag, a filter chip.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the ✕, e.g. "Remove tag alpha".

slots.name: remove
slots.description: Replaces the ✕ (with `removable`), for a chip whose remove control is another primitive's.

props.name: as
props.description:
Component for linked crumbs. By default `to` and internal `href` use the
link component from provideLpConfig and other hrefs a plain <a>.

props.name: as
props.description:
Root element/component. Defaults to a native <button>, or a link when
`to`/`href` is set (the link component from provideLpConfig for internal
targets). Pass a component or "a" to override.

props.name: to
props.description: Router destination: renders the configured link component.

props.name: href
props.description: Link URL: renders an anchor (or the link component for internal paths).

props.name: loading
props.description:
Busy state: blocks clicks like `disabled` without dimming, fades the label out
in place and shows a spinner over it, so the width never jumps. Sets `aria-busy`.

props.name: action
props.description:
Work the click starts. While it runs the button shows `loading` and
ignores further clicks; a failure is reported as an error toast with
the error's details, unless the app listens to `error` itself. The
state the work was for (a form, a switch) is the app's to roll back.

props.name: hotkey
props.description:
A key that presses the button: "Ctrl+S", "Shift+N", "F2". It works
wherever the button is on screen and not covered by a dialog, appears
in the key reference (F1) and the tooltip, and counts toward
`hotkeyTip()` for people who keep clicking instead.

props.name: hotkeyGroup
props.description: The key reference's section for `hotkey`.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Selected date as "YYYY-MM-DD" (v-model).

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date, "YYYY-MM-DD".

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date, "YYYY-MM-DD".

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Predicate to disable specific days; receives the ISO string.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Days shown struck through and not pickable (booked, sold out), as on LpRangeCalendar.

props.name: months
props.description: Months shown side by side.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the heading and weekdays; defaults to reka's ConfigProvider, then the browser.

props.name: menuItems
props.description: Right-click menu for the card. Omit (or pass []) to keep the native one.

props.name: menuTitle
props.description: Heading of the right-click menu: what the card stands for (its name).

props.name: menuSubtitle
props.description: A muted second line under `menuTitle`.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Content is still on its way. The card keeps its surface (border, padding,
accent) and shows a skeleton in place of the slot: the `#loading` slot when
given, written as the real layout with `.lp-skeleton-item` blocks, else a
few text lines. The swap to the content eases its height.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render as. A card inside a <ul> has to be an `li` to be valid.

props.name: accent
props.description:
Colour of a stripe down the card's leading edge. ANY CSS colour — this is
for sources that hand you an arbitrary value (a Discord role colour, a
per-project hex out of a config), which is why it is a string and not a
set of tonal variants. When the colour IS semantic, LpAlert's
info/success/warning/danger say so in a way a raw hex cannot.

The stripe costs no layout: content starts in the same place with and
without it, and it rounds into `rounded-card` by itself.

props.name: accentWidth
props.description: Width of the `accent` stripe.

props.name: spotlight
props.description:
A soft glow follows the mouse inside the card. For a grid of cards the
user scans with the pointer (a launcher's library, a gallery of builds):
the lit one is the one about to be clicked. Same effect as LpSpotlight.

props.name: glow
props.description:
A gradient runs round the edge — for the one card that must be noticed
first ("new", "recommended"). Same effect as LpGlowBorder; static where
the browser cannot animate it, still under reduced motion.

props.name: labels
props.description: Shared x-axis labels; a point's own `x` overrides its slot.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px. The width always fills the container.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline above the plot.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Sub-headline under the title.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Curve tension for line/area. 0 = straight polyline, 1 = fully smooth.

props.name: showPoints
props.description: Draw a dot at every point rather than only the hovered one.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Legend also toggles series visibility on click.

props.name: yTicks
props.description: Roughly how many y ticks to aim for; bounds are rounded to fit.

props.name: includeZero
props.description: Force the y-axis to include 0 (bars always do).

props.name: unit
props.description: Appended to values in ticks and the tooltip, e.g. "%" or " ms".

props.name: rightUnit
props.description: Unit for series on the right axis. Falls back to `unit`.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Custom value formatter; overrides the compact 1.2k default.

props.name: formatRightValue
props.description: Formatter for the right axis. Falls back to `formatValue`.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Stack bars instead of grouping them side by side.

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow the marks in on mount and on data change.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when every series is empty.

props.name: emptyDescription
props.description: Second line of the empty state: why it is empty, what period it covers.

props.name: emptyIcon
props.description: Icon of the empty state. The `empty` slot puts an action under it ("Show 90 days").

props.name: sample
props.description:
Inside a `v-hint` element with nothing to draw, a tour step on that hint
draws made-up data here instead of the empty state, tagged "Example".
Off: the empty state shows on the tour too.

props.name: loading
props.description:
The series are on their way. The plot keeps its `height` and draws a
pulsing stand-in of the chart's own type in the area the marks will take
(bars for `bar`, a line for line/area, tick stubs where the axes are), so
a dashboard does not jump from an empty box to a filled one.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Reference lines and bands (SLOs, budgets, alert levels).

props.name: markers
props.description: Vertical markers at x positions (deploys, incidents).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the plot. Defaults to a generated summary.

props.name: dataTable
props.description: Render the data as a visually hidden table for screen readers.

props.name: text
props.description: Text overrides (`labels` is taken by the x axis).

props.name: menuItems
props.description:
Right-click menu for a point, built from whatever was hit. Return [] to
leave the browser's own menu alone for that point. Which actions a point
offers is an application question — "compare with last week", "open the
incident", "copy value" — so the chart supplies the context and the
caller supplies the items.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Mixed state (e.g. a "select all" with a partial selection). Shows a dash.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary line under the label, as on LpSwitch.

props.name: action
props.description:
Saves the new state, as LpSwitch's `action`: the box ticks at once and
spins while this runs; a failure unticks it and becomes an error toast
(or the `error` event, when the app listens).

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The code (v-model when editable).

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Show 1-based gutter line numbers.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally.

props.name: locked
props.description: Read-only. Set false for an editable field with a lock toggle.

props.name: lockToggle
props.description: Show the lock/unlock toggle in the header (opt-in editability).

props.name: copyable
props.description: Show the copy button.

props.name: title
props.description: Caption shown in the header (e.g. a filename).

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height; defaults to content height.

props.name: foldImports
props.description: Auto-collapse a leading import/package block (no markers needed).

props.name: groups
props.description: One size for every group, or exact sizes in order. Unset picks 3s or 4s by length.

props.name: separator
props.description: Drawn between groups: `""` (a gap, the default), `"-"`, `"·"`, `" "`.

props.name: copyAs
props.description: Copy with separators (`grouped`) or the characters alone (`raw`, default).

props.name: masked
props.description: Hidden until revealed (v-model:revealed). Copy still works while hidden.

props.name: expiresAt
props.description: When the code stops working; shows a countdown.

props.name: issuedAt
props.description:
When it was issued, for the countdown bar's full length. Unset, the bar
starts full at the moment it first appears.

props.name: ack
props.description: Add the "I've saved this" confirmation (v-model:saved).

slots.name: expiry
slots.type: { remaining: number; formatted: string; expired: boolean; fraction: number; }

props.name: axis
props.description: Which dimension folds: `height` for a section, `width` for a side panel or a toolbar group, `both` for a corner pop-out.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the content along with the fold, so it does not show sliced while the box is small.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description:
Keep the content in the DOM while closed (hidden), so its state survives:
a half-filled form, a scroll position, a playing preview. Off, it is
unmounted once folded away, like `v-if`.

props.name: lazy
props.description: With `keepMounted`, do not mount the content until it is first opened: an expensive body costs nothing until asked for.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the fold in ms. Defaults to the kit's `--duration-medium`.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The colour as a CSS string (v-model). Hex, rgb()/rgba() or hsl()/hsla().

props.name: format
props.description: Shape of the emitted string. Parsing accepts all three either way.

props.name: alpha
props.description: Show the alpha rail and emit a colour carrying its alpha.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset colours under the rails. Pass [] to drop the row entirely.

props.name: hideInput
props.description: Hide the hex/CSS text field (leaves the field, rails and presets).

props.name: label
props.description: Trigger text beside the swatch. Defaults to the colour's own value.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the trigger when it carries no visible text.

props.name: side
props.description: Popover side, as LpPopover.

props.name: menu
props.description:
Right-click menu on the trigger. Copy-as-hex/rgb/hsl and paste are built
in — the thing a person actually wants from a colour swatch is to take
the value somewhere else, and reading it off the trigger by hand is how
a hex ends up mistyped. These come first; `menuItems` is appended below a
separator. Pass `menu="none"` to drop the built-ins and keep only yours.

props.name: menuItems
props.description: Extra right-click items, appended after the built-in ones.

props.name: recent
props.description:
Remember the colours picked here and offer them back as a "Recent" row.
A person who tints one tag reaches for the same colour on the next one,
and the presets cannot know it. Off by default: history is a per-person
convenience, and a component that wrote to storage uninvited would be a
surprise in a form that is meant to be stateless.

props.name: recentKey
props.description:
Storage key for that history, so two pickers can share a list or keep
separate ones (e.g. "lp.color.tag" vs "lp.color.calendar").

props.name: recentLimit
props.description: How many recent colours to keep.

props.name: labels
props.description: Translations for the strings the picker renders itself.

props.name: copyToast
props.description:
Toast raised after a successful copy, with `{value}` standing in for the
colour. `false` copies silently — for a page that already confirms it, or
one where a toast per copy would be noise. Unset, it is the `copyToast`
label ("Copied {value}"), so an app translates it with the rest of its
strings; a string here wins over the label.

slots.name: default
slots.type: { color: string; hsv: { h: number; s: number; v: number; a: number; }; }

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Bind a global ⌘K / Ctrl-K toggle.

props.name: search
props.description:
Commands fetched from the typed query — what reaches the things too many
(or too remote) to hand over as a list: people, files, tickets. Called
debounced, never for a query shorter than `minChars`, and only its
newest call counts: an earlier one that lands late is dropped, so a slow
response can't overwrite a fresher list. The abort signal may never
reach the transport (a Tauri invoke cannot be cancelled); the late
answer is discarded all the same. See CommandFetcher for what
`query` and `parsed` hold: the operators are stripped from the first,
and the palette applies them to the results itself.

Results join the static commands, so a palette can do both.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Wait after the last keystroke before `search` runs.

props.name: minChars
props.description: Shortest query `search` runs for, counted on its positive words.

props.name: recent
props.description:
Recently picked commands, newest first — bind it to storage and the
palette opens on what this person actually uses. An item is a root
command's id, or a RecentEntry for a pick made inside a mode or among
fetched results (the `remember` event hands over exactly what to
store; `pushRecent` adds it to a list). A root id only reorders
commands already in the list. An entry is found again down its path
of static children, then through `resolveRecent`, then from its own
`href`; what none of them finds is skipped, so a stored history never
resurrects a command that has gone away.

props.name: recentKey
props.description:
Let the palette keep the history itself, in localStorage under this key:
every pick is remembered, newest first, root ones as bare ids as before
and deeper ones as entries. Ignored while `recent` is bound, which
stays the way to store it somewhere else.

props.name: resolveRecent
props.description:
Finds the live command for a remembered pick the palette cannot find
itself: a result a fetcher returned, or one inside a mode whose
children are fetched. Gets the stored entry, with the command's
`recentData` as `data`; returns the command to show and run, or
nothing to drop it.

props.name: recentLimit
props.description: How many recent commands to surface.

props.name: recentLabel
props.description: Headings the palette adds itself.

props.name: labels
props.description: Footer hints and the mode chip, spelled out for translation.

props.name: excerptLines
props.description: Lines an `excerpt` may wrap to before it is clamped.

props.name: groupLimit
props.description:
Rows a group shows before folding the rest behind a "Show N more" row.
One provider answering with thirty people would otherwise push every
other group off the screen. 0 shows everything.

props.name: previewPane
props.description:
A pane beside the list showing the highlighted result in full — its
`preview` text, or the `preview` slot. For palettes that search
content rather than commands: the excerpt says why a row matched, the
pane lets it be read without leaving the page. It opens only for a row
with `preview` or `excerpt` (any row, with the slot, unless `hasPreview`
or the row's `noPreview` says otherwise): the dialog eases wider, the
pane slides in, and the text arrives paragraph by paragraph. A slot
that renders nothing for a row falls back to that built-in text.
Hidden below the md breakpoint, where there is no room beside the list.

The width is an inline style rather than a pair of classes: a base
width plus an `md:` override could be emitted by a consumer's Tailwind
build in an order where the base won, and the pane opened squeezed.

props.name: hasPreview
props.description:
Which rows the pane opens for. With a `#preview` slot every row would
otherwise qualify, and an app whose previews cover only some kinds of
row had to draw a placeholder for the rest. Return false and the pane
folds away for that row, as it does for a row without text. A row's
own `noPreview` wins over this.

props.name: glass
props.description:
Frosted glass instead of a solid panel: the page shows through,
blurred, under a lighter scrim (.lp-glass-overlay, .lp-scrim--light).
A look, not a behaviour, so it is the app's call: unset follows
`provideGlass`, and without one it is off.

slots.name: preview
slots.type: { command: Command; highlight: (text: string) => HighlightPart[]; query: PaletteQuery; }
slots.description:
Body of the preview pane for the highlighted command. `highlight(text)`
splits any text around the words typed (positive terms only, plus the
command's own `highlight` words), the same matching the rows use; the
LpPalette* blocks take its result wherever they take text, and
`query` is the parsed box for anything else.

props.name: danger
props.description:
The action destroys something. Colours the confirm button, and marks the
title with a warning glyph — a destructive prompt should be recognisable
before the words are read, since it is the one dialog people dismiss on
reflex.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Override the marker: any iconify name, or `""` to leave the title plain —
for a `danger` action whose dialog body already carries the warning and
would otherwise state it twice.

A string rather than `string | false`, deliberately: a union including
Boolean makes Vue boolean-cast the prop, so an absent `icon` would arrive
as `false` and be indistinguishable from a caller suppressing the marker.

props.name: loading
props.description:
The confirm action is in flight: the button disables and swaps to
`loadingLabel`, and confirming no longer closes the dialog — the owner
closes it once the work settles, so a failure can stay on screen.
Setting it from the `confirm` handler is enough; the dialog waits a tick
for it before deciding to close.

props.name: action
props.description:
The work behind the confirm button. When given, the dialog runs it,
shows the loading state itself, closes once it resolves and stays open
with the error's message when it rejects.

props.name: glass
props.description: Frosted glass panel, passed to LpModal. Follows `provideGlass` when unset.

props.name: glass
props.description: Frosted glass panel. Follows `provideGlass` when unset.

props.name: always
props.description:
Keep the reka menu mounted even while `items` is momentarily empty. Use when
the items are resolved on the right-click itself (e.g. a list that figures
out which row was clicked): without this the trigger would still be in
native-menu mode on that first click and swallow it.

props.name: title
props.description:
What the menu acts on, shown as a heading above the items: the row's name
in a list of similar rows, so the user sees which one the right-click hit.
Also names the menu for assistive tech.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A muted second line under `title`, e.g. a version or a path.

props.name: titleIcon
props.description: An icon beside the title, or `titleImage` for a picture (an avatar, a logo).

props.name: noHint
props.description:
Do not count this element as "has a right-click menu" for hint tips: for
menus that only hold generic items (a whole table without row actions).

props.name: value
props.description: The text to copy, or a (possibly async) function that returns it on click.

props.name: size
props.description: LpButton's sizes, so it sits in a toolbar of buttons at the same height.

props.name: iconSize
props.description:
Glyph size in px, for a toolbar whose other icons are drawn at their
own size (the lightbox's 18px row). Defaults to what suits `size`.

props.name: variant
props.description: LpButton's look. `ghost` by default: a copy button is a helper beside something, not a call to action.

props.name: label
props.description:
Visible text beside the icon. Without it the button is a square icon
button and the tip names it.

props.name: toast
props.description: A toast on success too, for a copy whose button is about to leave the screen (a menu, a closing dialog).

props.name: copied
props.description:
Show the tick now, for a copy made some other way: a Ctrl+C shortcut on
the row, a "Copy" item in its menu. The button then confirms it too, so
there is one place that says the clipboard holds this value.

props.name: side
props.description: Where the tip opens.

props.name: to
props.description: The moment to count down to. Takes precedence over `seconds`.

props.name: seconds
props.description:
Count down this many seconds from when the countdown mounts — or from
when this value changes, or `restart()` is called. For "try again in 45
s", where the app has a wait rather than a moment.

props.name: from
props.description:
`to` only: when the wait began, so the ring or bar can show how much of
it is left. Without it a `to` countdown draws no progress.

props.name: format
props.description: `auto` is a clock under an hour and units above it.

props.name: places
props.description: Units format: how many places to keep ("2d 3h" is 2).

props.name: paused
props.description:
Freeze the count. A `seconds` countdown resumes where it stopped; a `to`
countdown is tied to a real moment, so it resumes at the true time left.

props.name: progress
props.description: Draw the time left as a ring around the digits, or a bar under them.

props.name: ringSize
props.description: Ring only: outer diameter in px.

props.name: urgentAt
props.description: Seconds left at which it turns danger: the end is close enough to act on.

props.name: announce
props.description:
Announce the time left at these marks (ms remaining) and at the end.
`false` keeps it silent apart from what the timer role itself offers.

slots.name: done
slots.description: Replaces the digits once the time is up: a "Resend" button, "Live now".

props.name: layout
props.description:
`auto` (default) is side by side, stacking when the list itself is
narrower than ~20rem. `horizontal` and `stacked` fix one.

props.name: divided
props.description: Hairlines between rows, for a long list read as a table.

slots.name: value
slots.type: { item: DataListItem; value: string | number | null | undefined; }

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Selected date "YYYY-MM-DD" (v-model).

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Days shown struck through and not pickable, as on LpDateRangePicker.

props.name: presets
props.description:
Shortcut days beside the calendar. `true` shows the built-in set (Today,
Tomorrow, In a week); a list replaces it. Off by default.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the shown date and the calendar; defaults to reka's ConfigProvider, then the browser.

props.name: format
props.description: Intl format for the displayed date.

props.name: time
props.description: Also pick a minute; the model becomes "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm".

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: Time a freshly picked day starts at, "HH:mm".

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Label of the button that closes the popover in `time` mode. Wins over `labels.done`.

props.name: labels
props.description:
The picker's own text, plus `previous` / `next` handed on to the
calendar inside (whose app-wide scope is "calendar").

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Selected range (v-model).

props.name: maximumDays
props.description: Longest allowed range, in days.

props.name: presets
props.description: Shortcut ranges; an empty list hides them. Defaults to the built-in set.

props.name: format
props.description: Intl format for the displayed ends.

props.name: labels
props.description:
The picker's own text, plus `previous` / `next` handed on to the
calendar inside (whose app-wide scope is "rangeCalendar").

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit to let the component own it (with `defaultOpen`).

props.name: label
props.description: Trigger label (or use the #trigger slot for richer content).

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional iconify name shown left of the label.

props.name: scrollIntoView
props.description:
On open, smooth-scroll the block to the top of the nearest scroll
container so its content isn't left below the fold. Fires immediately,
in parallel with the expand.

props.name: active
props.description: Ids marked with a dot: running, open, or the current section.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Lay the bar out in a row or a column.

props.name: size
props.description: Resting icon size in px.

props.name: magnify
props.description: Size of the icon right under the pointer, in px. Equal to `size` turns magnification off.

props.name: reach
props.description: How far, in px, the swell reaches to either side of the pointer.

props.name: tooltipSide
props.description: Which side the tooltips open on; defaults to away from the bar's edge.

props.name: focusAt
props.description:
Drive the swell from outside — a pointer position along the bar, in px
from its start. For demos and guided tours; `null` hands it back to the
pointer.

props.name: direction
props.description: Edge the drawer attaches to. `side` is a back-compat alias (left/right).

props.name: size
props.description: Size preset along the drawer's main axis (width for left/right, height for top/bottom).

props.name: width
props.description: Explicit size override (any CSS length), wins over `size`.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Drag-to-dismiss + click-outside. Set false to force a controlled close.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Fractions (0–1) or px strings the drawer snaps between, nearest edge first.

props.name: handle
props.description: Show the drag handle (auto-on for bottom/top sheets).

props.name: handleOnly
props.description: Only the handle initiates a drag — frees inner content to scroll.

props.name: scaleBackground
props.description: Scale the [vaul-drawer-wrapper] background while open.

props.name: closeThreshold
props.description: Drag fraction (0–1) past which a release dismisses.

props.name: noDragControls
props.description:
Auto-tag interactive descendants (input, textarea, select, button, links,
[contenteditable]) with data-vaul-no-drag so a drag can't start on them —
you can select text / use controls without dragging the drawer. On by
default; the drawer still drags from empty space, the handle and header.

props.name: noDragContent
props.description:
Mark the entire body as non-draggable: the drawer then only drags from the
handle/header. Stronger than noDragControls — use for form-heavy drawers.

props.name: edgeOpen
props.description:
Open by dragging in from the screen edge (Discord-style). A touch that
starts within `edgeSize` of the edge and travels inward drags a preview of
the panel (with its content) under the finger; a release past
`edgeOpenThreshold`, or a quick flick, opens the drawer. Nothing is laid
over the edge, so taps there still reach the page. Left/right drawers only.

props.name: edgeBreakpoint
props.description:
Tailwind breakpoint at and above which the edge pull is ignored. Pass the
same breakpoint at which the host switches to the drawer (LpSidebar
does), so a wide touch screen with the rail visible doesn't pull it too.

props.name: edgeSize
props.description: Distance (px) from the edge within which a touch can start a pull.

props.name: edgeOpenThreshold
props.description: Fraction (0–1) of the panel width the pull must reach to open on release.

props.name: resizable
props.description:
Let the user drag the inner edge to resize the panel (horizontal drawers
only — e.g. a logs panel whose long lines overflow). The new size is kept
for the session. Min/max bound the drag.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Min main-axis size while resizing (any CSS length). Default 22rem.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Max main-axis size while resizing (any CSS length). Default 96vw.

props.name: persist
props.description:
Remember the width the user dragged to under this key, across visits
(in the kit's storage, see `usePersisted`). Without it the width lasts
as long as the component.

props.name: guard
props.description:
Something would be lost by closing: `true` asks "Discard changes?" first
(and warns on leaving the page), a function asks the app. While a guard
is set the drawer closes by its button, the scrim or Escape only: a
swipe has already carried the panel away before it could be asked.

props.name: glass
props.description:
Frosted glass instead of a solid panel: the page shows through,
blurred, under a lighter scrim (.lp-glass-overlay, .lp-scrim--light).
A look, not a behaviour, so it is the app's call: unset follows
`provideGlass`, and without one it is off.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for a drawer without a visible `title`.

props.name: title
props.description: A heading naming what the menu acts on; see LpContextMenu's `title`.

props.name: rightClickToo
props.description:
The same items are also on a right click (a row's "…" next to its context
menu). Opening it then counts toward the hint system's right-click tip.

props.name: accept
props.description: Same syntax as the input's: "image/*", ".yaml,.yml".

props.name: multiple
props.description: Take more than one at a time.

props.name: dragOver
props.description:
A drag the page itself cannot see is over the zone. Desktop shells
(Tauri, Electron) often take file drags natively, and the page then gets
no dragenter or dragover at all, only the shell's own events; the app
hit-tests those and passes the answer here so the zone lights up the same.

props.name: pasteTarget
props.description:
Also accept a paste anywhere on the page, not only while focused.
Off by default: two zones both listening would each take the same
screenshot, and a page with one obvious target is the case for it.

props.name: maxBytes
props.description:
Largest file accepted, in bytes. Bigger ones are rejected, not silently
dropped — a picture that vanishes reads as a broken uploader.

props.name: tone
props.description:
How the well sits against what holds it. A drop target reads as a hole
in the surface, not a tile on top of it, so the default is darker than
the card — which is what a dashed border is already suggesting.
`flush` for a zone that fills a panel of its own, `soft` when it sits
directly on the page background and needs to lift off it instead.

props.name: animate
props.description: Draw the entrance when the zone first comes into view.

props.name: links
props.description:
Also take an address: dropped from another page, pasted, or typed after
"or a link". Arrives as the `link` event.

props.name: label
props.description: What the text is, for assistive tech ("Server name").

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown when the text is empty; clicking it starts editing.

props.name: multiline
props.description: A textarea; Enter adds a line and Ctrl/⌘+Enter commits.

props.name: save
props.description:
Persists the new text. May be async and may throw: a throw reopens the
field with the typed text and shows the error's message.

props.name: validate
props.type: ((value: string) => string | true | void | null | undefined) | undefined
props.description:
Checks the text before saving. Return an error message to refuse it
(the field stays open with the message under it), anything else to accept.

props.name: trim
props.description: Trim spaces around the text on commit.

props.name: required
props.description: Refuse an empty commit (with the `required` message) instead of saving "".

props.name: readonly
props.description: Shown as text, never editable — for a viewer without the right to change it.

props.name: compact
props.description:
Tightens the block for empty states nested inside a card or a panel,
where the full-page padding would dwarf its container.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected node id (v-model:selected).

props.name: expanded
props.description: Expanded directory ids (v-model:expanded). Omit to let the tree own it.

props.name: persist
props.description:
Remember which folders are open across visits under this key (the
kit's storage, see `usePersisted`), when the tree owns its expansion.

props.name: loadingIds
props.description: Directory ids currently fetching children — shows a spinner on the row.

props.name: checkable
props.description:
Multi-select mode: every row gets a tri-state checkbox and ticking a
directory cascades to its loaded subtree. This is the mode for "pick what
to back up" — `selected` stays independent (it's the highlighted row).

props.name: checked
props.description: Ticked node ids (v-model:checked).

props.name: showSize
props.description: Right-aligned size column (directories roll up their subtree).

props.name: showModified
props.description: Right-aligned last-modified column.

props.name: sort
props.description: Directories first, then by name. Turn off to keep the caller's order.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Row icon size in px.

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeleton rows while the initial listing loads.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Empty-state copy when `nodes` is empty.

slots.type: { node: FileNode; depth: number; expanded: boolean; selected: boolean; }
slots.description: Replace the row's label (icons, chevron and indent stay).

slots.name: summary
slots.description: Footer under the tree, handed the live selection stats.

props.name: depth
props.description: Nesting depth, 0 at the root — drives the indent guide and aria-level.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Rendered size of the row's icon, in px.

props.name: checkable
props.description: Render a tri-state checkbox per row (multi-select mode).

props.name: stats
props.description: Per-node state, derived once by the root for the whole tree.

slots.type: { node: FileNode; depth: number; expanded: boolean; selected: boolean; }

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the control; generated when unset. The label points at it.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height (px or any CSS length). Without it the frame grows with its content.

props.name: title
props.description: Read by assistive technology for the frame as a whole.

props.name: thresholds
props.description:
Steps of the scale, in the gauge's own units: from each `at` upward the
arc takes that tone. Unset, the capacity scale applies (warning from 80%
of the range, danger from 90%), which is what a resource gauge wants. A
score where higher is better lists its own steps:
`[{ at: 0, tone: 'danger' }, { at: 50, tone: 'warning' }, { at: 80, tone: 'ok' }]`.

props.name: tone
props.description:
A fixed tone instead of the scale. For a gauge whose reading is neither
good nor bad (a temperature, a position), where colouring it by
thresholds would invent a judgement.

props.name: label
props.description: What is measured, printed under the figure ("CPU", "Disk"). Also the accessible name.

props.name: unit
props.description: Printed after the figure, smaller ("%", "°C", "ms").

props.name: decimals
props.description: Decimal places of the figure.

props.name: format
props.description:
Says the figure differently ("1.2k", "3/8"). Overrides `decimals`; the
figure still rolls, since the formatted string is what LpNumberFlow animates.

props.name: variant
props.description: `semi` (default) sweeps across the top; `full` is a 270° dial open at the bottom.

props.name: size
props.description: Width in px. The height follows from the shape.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Arc thickness in px. Defaults to a share of `size`.

props.name: showRange
props.description: Print `min` and `max` under the ends of the arc. On by default for `semi`, where they sit naturally.

props.name: showThresholds
props.description: Notch the track where each threshold starts, so the reader sees how far the next step is.

props.name: animateOnMount
props.description:
Sweep up from the floor when first seen, instead of appearing already
at the reading. Later changes always ease from where the needle is.

props.name: duration
props.description: Sweep length in ms, shared by the arc and the figure.

props.name: from
props.description: Leading colour of the gradient. Defaults to the brand colour.

props.name: to
props.description: Trailing colour of the gradient. Defaults to the action colour.

props.name: width
props.description: Ring thickness in px.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds per revolution. Slower reads as calm, faster as urgent.

props.name: active
props.description:
Light the ring. Off keeps the wrapper (so the layout does not change when
an item stops being "new") and removes only the ring.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render as.

props.name: hint
props.description: The hint id this stands in for, as in `v-hint`, or several for a sample with parts.

props.name: fresh
props.description: Ids to mark, most important first.

props.name: limit
props.description: At most this many dots at once, so a page full of news stays calm.
