props.name: openDelay
props.description:
Milliseconds the pointer rests before the card opens. Longer than a
tooltip's on purpose: a card is big, and one that opens while the
pointer is only passing by covers what the reader was heading for.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds after the pointer leaves before it closes: room to cross the gap to the card.

props.name: arrow
props.description: A small pointer from the card to its trigger, for a trigger in a dense row where the card could belong to a neighbour.

props.name: touch
props.description: Touch: `hold` opens on press-and-hold; `none` leaves touch to the trigger.

props.name: holdDelay
props.description: How long a touch must be held to open, in ms.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turn the card off: the trigger stays and behaves as itself.

props.name: panelClass
props.description: Extra classes for the card (width, padding). Merged, so `w-80 p-0` replaces the defaults.

props.name: name
props.description: iconify name, e.g. "lucide:check". Bare names assume the lucide set.

props.name: seed
props.description: What the picture is derived from. Use something stable: an id outlives a renamed username.

props.name: grid
props.description: Cells per side: 5 is the familiar look, 7 gives busier shapes for large sizes.

props.name: background
props.description:
`tint` lays a pale wash of the shape's own hue behind it, mixed into the
theme's soft surface so it sits right on dark and light alike; `none`
leaves the box behind it showing.

props.name: padding
props.description: Empty margin around the grid as a share of the side; more for a round crop.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Unset, the picture is decorative: the name is usually written next to it.

props.name: file
props.description: The picture to work on: a file, or an http(s)/data address.

props.name: aspect
props.description:
Shape of the crop box.

The named ones are shorthand for the common cases; a NUMBER is the real
interface — `:aspect="2.35"` for anamorphic, `:aspect="0.8"` for a
shelf label — so a consumer whose shape is not on the list is not stuck
choosing the nearest wrong one. "free" keeps the source's own
proportions and crops only what panning and zoom leave outside.

props.name: maxEdge
props.description: Longest edge of the exported image. Larger sources are scaled down.

props.name: type
props.description:
Encoding of the export; read the result's `blob.type` for the one used.

JPEG, the default, is the smallest for photographs, the case this was
built for. It has no alpha channel, though: a transparent PNG comes back
with its background filled black, and a logo or an icon is ruined by the
crop. "source" keeps the picture's own format where a canvas can write it
(PNG, JPEG, WebP) and falls back to PNG for the ones it cannot (GIF, BMP,
SVG), so transparency survives either way. An animated GIF still comes
back as its first frame: a canvas holds one picture.

props.name: quality
props.description: Quality of a lossy export (JPEG, WebP); PNG ignores it.

props.name: labels
props.description:
Labels for the toolbar. Defaulted in English rather than left blank: an
icon button with no accessible name is announced as "button", and the
kit cannot reach the consumer's translations. Apps with i18n pass their
own strings.

props.name: animate
props.description: Fade the picture in when the editor first comes into view.

props.name: roles
props.description: Extra/overriding role styles, merged over the defaults below.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show an accessible clear button, returning focus to the input.

props.name: required
props.description:
Marks the label with the required indicator. The attribute still reaches
the underlying <input> for native validation; this only makes the field
read as required.

props.name: pattern
props.description:
RegExp/string the whole value must match to be valid. Validation only —
never blocks typing; a non-matching non-empty value shows the invalid
style + aria-invalid. A bare string is anchored, like HTML `pattern`.

props.name: restrict
props.description:
One-char RegExp of allowed characters (e.g. /[0-9]/). Hard-blocks
disallowed input/paste at the source — cursor- and IME-safe.

props.name: mask
props.description:
Format-as-you-type mask ("+0 (000) 000-00-00", a list, or a function of
the raw value). The model holds the masked text; `update:raw` carries
the accepted characters alone.

props.name: maskTokens
props.description: Extra or replacement mask tokens, one-character RegExps by key.

props.name: combo
props.description: "Ctrl+K", "Ctrl++", or a sequence "G I". Or keys already split.

props.name: label
props.description: Text after the caps, e.g. what the keys do.

props.name: items
props.description: Images to page through.

props.name: index
props.description: Index of the visible image (v-model:index).

props.name: filmstrip
props.description: Thumbnail strip along the bottom. Defaults on when there's more than one.

props.name: rotatable
props.description: Show the rotate control.

props.name: downloadable
props.description: Show the download control.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Show "copy image" — needs a same-origin or CORS-readable source.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last image back to the first.

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: Largest zoom level.

slots.name: caption
slots.type: { item: LightboxItem; index: number; total: number; }
slots.description: Replace the caption block under the image.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Extra controls in the toolbar, before the close button.

props.name: to
props.description: Router destination; rendered through the configured link component.

props.name: muted
props.description: Shorthand for `tone="muted"`.

props.name: tone
props.description:
"brand" — the accent link colour (default).
"ink"   — inherits body text colour; for links that sit inside prose or
  chrome where an accent would shout (breadcrumbs, footers, nav).
"muted" / "soft" — progressively quieter, both resolving to ink on hover.

props.name: as
props.description:
Root element/component. By default an internal `to`/`href` renders the
link component set with provideLpConfig (NuxtLink under the Nuxt module),
anything else a native <a>. Pass a component here to override per link.

props.name: variant
props.description:
"default" — plain hover underline.
"underline" — underlined at rest; for links inside running prose,
  where hover-only underlines leave the link invisible until pointed at.
"reveal"  — an underline bar that grows in from the left on hover
  (origin-left scale-x 0→1). The LeavePulse landing "monitoring" link feel;
  good for inline prose links and nav items that want a bit of motion.

props.name: revealOn
props.description:
Which hover draws the `reveal` bar.

"self"  — the link's own hover (default), for an inline prose link.
"group" — the hover of an ancestor marked `group`, for a link inside a
  row or card that is itself the click target. The row lights up and the
  name sweeps with it, instead of the bar waiting for the pointer to
  cross the text exactly.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`spinner` for a spot (a button, a row, a field); `dots` for something
conversational (typing, connecting); `bar` for a region across its width
(the top of a card or a page).

props.name: size
props.description:
`inline` sizes the mark from the font (a 1em spinner), so it fits a
button or a line of text at whatever size that text is.

props.name: tone
props.description:
`current` takes the surrounding text colour, which is what a loader
inside a button or a coloured badge wants; the others pin a kit tone.

props.name: active
props.description:
Whether work is under way. Off, the loader is not shown (or, with a
default slot, the content is). Leave it on and mount the loader with
`v-if` when it has nothing to swap with.

props.name: delay
props.description:
Ms of loading before anything appears. Most requests finish inside 150
ms; a spinner for those is a blink, not information. 0 shows at once —
the right call where the trigger already acknowledged the click (a
button that faded its label).

props.name: minVisible
props.description: Ms the loader stays once shown, so a load ending just after it appeared does not blink it away.

props.name: label
props.description:
Visible text beside the indicator. Without it the indicator is still
announced, with the `loading` label, to screen readers only.

props.name: track
props.description: Spinner only: draw the faint full circle the arc runs along.

props.name: showTime
props.description: Show the timestamp column.

props.name: showLevel
props.description:
Show the per-line level chip (INFO/WARN/…). On by default. Turn off for
raw streams (e.g. docker logs) where most lines have no real level and a
blanket "INFO" chip is just noise — the tonal level RAIL still renders, so
errors/warnings stay visually distinct.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Show 1-based gutter line numbers.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Case-insensitive substring to highlight in message bodies.

props.name: filterMatches
props.description: When set with `highlight`, hide every line that doesn't match.

props.name: compact
props.description: Collapse consecutive identical lines into one, badged with a ×N count.

props.name: tail
props.description: Pin to the bottom as new lines arrive (until the user scrolls up).

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height. Anything CSS-valid; defaults to a comfortable terminal.

props.name: frozenLabel
props.description:
Shown while the stream is held. Defaulted in English; apps with i18n
pass their own.

props.name: loadingOlder
props.description:
When true, a "loading older…" row is shown pinned at the top — set it while
fetching a previous page in response to `reach-top`, clear it when done.

props.name: loadOlder
props.description:
When true, the viewer emits `reach-top` as the user scrolls near the top so
the consumer can prepend older history (infinite scroll-back). The viewer
preserves the scroll position across a prepend so the view doesn't jump.

props.name: rowMenu
props.description:
Right-click row menu: built-in copy actions (+ "filter by" when the line
has a source/level). Set false to disable; the row keeps the native menu.

props.name: extraRowItems
props.description: Extra menu items per line, appended below the built-ins with a divider.

props.name: parse
props.description:
Recognise common log formats inside each `message` and lift the level,
timestamp and [source] out of the text into the dedicated columns. When a
line already carries an explicit `level`/`time`/`source`, those win and
the message is left untouched. Off by default (raw). Handles e.g.:
  "2025-01-02T03:04:05.123Z INFO [auth] user logged in"
  "[2025-01-02 03:04:05] WARN: disk almost full"
  "ERROR something broke"
so a duplicate level word / timestamp doesn't repeat in the message body.

props.name: maxLines
props.description:
Keep only the newest N lines on screen. The consumer can keep pushing
into the same array (or hand over a longer one) and the viewer shows the
tail; trimming the source itself is still the cheaper way to cap memory.

props.name: toolbar
props.description:
A bar above the stream with a search box (Enter / Shift+Enter or F3 step
through matches) and level chips. The term binds via `v-model:search`,
the chosen levels via `v-model:levels`.

props.name: persist
props.description:
Remember the level chips across visits under this key (the kit's
storage, see `usePersisted`): someone who only ever reads errors should
not pick them again every time.

props.name: search
props.description: The toolbar's search term. Without the toolbar, `highlight` is the term.

props.name: levels
props.description: Levels to show. Empty shows every level.

events.name: filter
events.type: [by: { source?: string | undefined; level?: LogLevel | undefined; }]

props.name: reach
props.description: How far past the element's edge, in px, the pull is felt.

props.name: strength
props.description: Fraction of the pointer's distance the element travels, 0–1. Small is better.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Keep the wrapper, turn the pull off.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Picked point. Bind with v-model; undefined leaves the map unpinned.

props.name: tiles
props.description: Tile server. Defaults to OpenStreetMap; swap for your own.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Zoom used on first paint, and when a point arrives from outside.

props.name: center
props.description: Where to look when there is no point yet.

props.name: height
props.description: Any CSS length.

props.name: locatable
props.description: Offer the "use my location" control (needs a secure context).

props.name: mapLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the map itself.

props.name: itemKey
props.type: keyof T | ((item: T, index: number) => string | number) | undefined
props.description: Field (or function) giving each item a stable identity, so it keeps its element across changes.

props.name: columns
props.description:
Fixed column count, or a table of minimum container widths to counts
(`{ 0: 1, 560: 2, 900: 3 }`). Omit to fit as many `minColumnWidth`
columns as the container allows — the right default, because a masonry
usually lives in a panel whose width the viewport does not decide.

props.name: minColumnWidth
props.description: Narrowest a column may get when the count is derived from the width.

props.name: maxColumns
props.description: Upper bound for the derived count.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items, in px, both ways.

props.name: entrance
props.description: Play the entrance when the block is first seen. Off shows it as is.

props.name: items
props.description: Images in the set. The same shape LpLightbox takes.

props.name: columns
props.type: number | { base?: number | undefined; sm?: number | undefined; md?: number | undefined; lg?: number | undefined; xl?: number | undefined; } | undefined
props.description:
Thumbnails per row. A number is that many at every width; an object is
per breakpoint, e.g. `{ base: 2, md: 3, lg: 4 }`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between thumbnails, as a Tailwind gap step.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Shape of each cell. `auto` lets the image decide its own height.

props.name: max
props.description:
Show at most this many, with the remainder as a "+N" badge over the last
visible one — the usual treatment for a set too big for the space it has.
Clicking the badge opens the lightbox at the first hidden image, because
that is the one the count is about.

props.name: openable
props.description: Open the lightbox on click. Off makes the grid a pure display.

props.name: downloadable
props.description: Passed through to the lightbox.

props.name: rotatable
props.description: Passed through to the lightbox.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the grid. Defaults to the `gallery` label.

props.name: itemMenu
props.description:
Right-click menu for a thumbnail (download, copy link, set as cover…),
headed by the image's title and the thumbnail itself. Return [] for an
image without one; it keeps the browser's own menu.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ gallery: string; image: string; spoiler: string; showSpoiler: string; showMore: string; }> | undefined

slots.name: item
slots.description: Replace a cell's contents. Gets the item and its index.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Shown instead of the grid when `items` is empty.

props.name: size
props.description:
Max content width preset. sm≈24rem … xl≈42rem, 2xl≈56rem, 3xl≈72rem,
full≈96vw (near-fullscreen, for dense catalogues).

props.name: width
props.description: Explicit width override (any CSS length), wins over `size`.

props.name: fillBody
props.description:
Let the body fill the available height as a flex column instead of
scrolling itself. Use for dense dashboards that own their inner scroll
regions (e.g. multi-pane catalogues) — the panes scroll, not the modal.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description:
Where the keyboard lands when the dialog opens. Default `"auto"` picks
the first meaningful control in the body — a field to type in, or failing
that the primary action — instead of the close button, which is what
happens if the DOM order is left to decide.

`"none"` leaves reka's own behaviour alone; pass a CSS selector to name
the element yourself.

props.name: glass
props.description:
Frosted glass instead of a solid panel: the page shows through,
blurred, under a lighter scrim (.lp-glass-overlay, .lp-scrim--light).
A look, not a behaviour, so it is the app's call: unset follows
`provideGlass`, and without one it is off.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description:
Accessible name for a dialog without a visible `title`. Rendered as a
visually hidden title, so assistive tech still announces what opened.

props.name: role
props.description: `alertdialog` for a prompt that interrupts the user (a confirmation).

props.name: dismissible
props.description:
Escape and a click on the scrim close the dialog (the default). False
leaves only the close button and the app's own buttons, for a step the
user must finish or cancel on purpose.

props.name: guard
props.description:
Something would be lost by closing: `true` asks "Discard changes?" first
(and warns on leaving the page), a function asks the app. Bind it to the
form's state, `:guard="form.dirty"`. See `useCloseGuard`.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Active section id (v-model).

props.name: items
props.description: Flat sections, or grouped ones — the shapes LpSidebar already takes.

props.name: navWidth
props.description: Width of the nav rail (any CSS length).

props.name: searchable
props.description: Put a filter above the nav — see LpSidebar's `searchable`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeleton rows in place of the nav while the sections load.

props.name: mobileBreakpoint
props.description: Breakpoint below which the rail becomes a drawer.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Label for the button that opens that drawer.

props.name: navSide
props.description: Stand the rail to the right of the dialog instead of the left.

props.name: fillBody
props.description:
Let the body fill the height instead of scrolling itself. Off by default,
as in a plain modal: it existed here to make the rail a full-height
column inside the body, and the rail is no longer in the body.

props.name: glass
props.description: Frosted glass panel, passed to LpModal. Follows `provideGlass` when unset.

props.name: unreadCount
props.description: Unread count for the badge; falls back to counting unread items.

props.name: maxBadge
props.description: Cap the badge display (e.g. "9+").

props.name: menuItems
props.description: Right-click menu items; overrides the built-in quick actions.

props.name: labels
props.description: Translations for the strings the bell renders itself.

props.name: formatTime
props.description:
Formats `item.createdAt` for display. Defaults to a narrow relative time
in the app's locale ("now", "5m ago", "3h ago"); pass your own to word
it differently.

props.name: step
props.description:
What the steppers and arrow keys add. A typed value is snapped to the
nearest step from `min` (or 0) when it is committed, unless `stepSnapping`
is false: then 0.37 stays 0.37 in a field that steps by 0.5.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description:
How the value is shown and, with it, how far it is rounded: the field
commits the number it displays, so `{ maximumFractionDigits: 0 }` makes it
an integer field. Intl options, read in `locale` (the document's by default).

props.name: readonly
props.description: Shown and focusable, not changed: typing, the steppers, arrows and the wheel all stop.

props.name: disableWheelChange
props.description: The wheel over a focused field steps the value unless this is set.

props.name: focusOnChange
props.description: A step from the buttons moves focus to the input (reka's default); false keeps it on the button.

props.name: steppers
props.description:
The − and + buttons. Off, the field is a plain numeric input; arrow keys
still step. A field narrower than 8.5rem drops them by itself: two 32 px
buttons left a 100 px column eleven pixels for the digits.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height, matching LpInput.

props.name: duration
props.description: Travel time in ms. Distance changes the feel, not the duration.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fixed decimal places. Ignored under `compact`.

props.name: compact
props.description:
Abbreviate large numbers — 1.2k, 3.4M. Off by default: an exact figure
should stay exact unless asked otherwise.

props.name: grouped
props.description: Thousands separators. Ignored under `compact`.

props.name: format
props.description: Custom formatter; overrides compact/decimals/grouped entirely.

props.name: animateOnMount
props.description: Start from 0 on first render rather than showing the value outright.

props.name: trend
props.description:
Force the roll direction: "up" and "down" make every column travel the
same way regardless of the digit, which reads as one mechanism turning.
"auto" lets each column take the shorter route.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The code as one string, e.g. "123456". Bind with v-model.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of cells.

props.name: mask
props.description: Mask entered characters (•) — for sensitive codes.

props.name: alphanumeric
props.description: Allow letters too (backup codes). Default: digits only (TOTP).

props.name: uppercase
props.description:
Turn typed letters into capitals, and open a phone's keyboard in capitals.
Default: on with `alphanumeric`, where codes are printed in capitals and
compared without regard to case; pass `false` for a case-sensitive code.

props.name: group
props.description:
Draw a separator after every `group` cells (e.g. 3 for "123-456"), or
after blocks of the exact sizes given (`[4, 6, 5]`), as LpCodeDisplay's
`groups` splits the printed code.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Error state — tints the cells red (e.g. wrong code).

props.name: page
props.description: Current page, 1-based (v-model:page).

props.name: total
props.description: Total item count — used with pageSize to derive the page count.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Direct page count; wins over total/pageSize when given.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one in the inner run.

props.name: title
props.description: Small heading over the list.

props.name: plain
props.description: Plain rows instead of soft tiles, for a list read as text.

props.name: title
props.description: Text, or the preview slot's `highlight(text)` to mark the query.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon beside the title, on a soft tile.

props.name: image
props.description: Picture beside the title; wins over `icon`, which becomes its fallback.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between blocks.

props.name: columns
props.description: Tiles per row.

props.name: background
props.description: The surface the swatches sit on, usually the theme's own.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the strip, e.g. the theme's name.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height, as on LpInput.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the text shows; bind it to reveal or hide from outside.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Full phone string, e.g. "+380501234567". Bind with v-model.

props.name: only
props.description: Restrict the country list (ISO2 codes). Omit for all countries.

props.name: defaultCountry
props.description: Default country (ISO2) used when the field is empty.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Unset shows an example number for the active country.

props.name: size
props.description: Outer diameter in px.

props.name: innerRatio
props.description: Donut only: hole diameter as a fraction of the outer radius (0–1).

props.name: maxSlices
props.description:
Keep the largest N-1 slices and sum the rest into "Other". `0` disables
the fold and draws every slice — for a caller that knows its data is
already few, or that would rather show a crowded circle than a bucket.

props.name: otherLabel
props.description: Label for the folded remainder.

props.name: sortBySize
props.description:
Draw the slices largest-first instead of in the order given. Ranking
always decides which slices survive `maxSlices`; this decides whether it
also reorders them.

props.name: unit
props.description: Appended to values in the legend and tooltip, e.g. " GB".

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Custom value formatter; overrides the compact 1.2k default.

props.name: labels
props.description:
Name the slices with leader lines around the circle instead of a legend
beside it. Better when the labels are long and self-explanatory (versions,
hostnames) and the reader wants share-per-name without cross-referencing a
colour; the legend stays better for short, repeated categories.

props.name: labelWidth
props.description: Callout width reserved for text on each side, in px.

props.name: showLegend
props.description:
Defaults to true, except in `labels` mode — callouts already name every
slice, and a legend beside them says the same thing twice. Set it
explicitly to have both.

props.name: showPercent
props.description: Print each slice's percentage next to its legend entry.

props.name: showTotal
props.description: Donut only: print the total in the hole. Ignored when #center is used.

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between slices in degrees — reads as separate parts, not one disc.

props.name: cornerRadius
props.description: Corner radius of each slice in px. 0 for hard edges.

props.name: hoverOffset
props.description: How far the hovered slice lifts out of the circle, in px.

props.name: animate
props.description:
Sweep the circle open, clockwise from twelve, when it first comes into
view. Turn it off where several are drawn at once and the sweeps would
compete rather than read as one arrival.

props.name: duration
props.description: Sweep time in ms.

props.name: menuItems
props.description:
Right-click menu, built from the slice that was hit and the whole current
selection — so an action can apply to one slice or to all the picked ones.

props.name: loading
props.description:
The slices are on their way. A pulsing ring (a disc for `pie`) of the
chart's own size stands in, with legend rows beside it when there will be
a legend, and eases into the real chart when the data lands.

props.name: skeletonRows
props.description: Legend rows drawn while loading.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the chart. Defaults to a generated summary.

props.name: dataTable
props.description: Render the slices as a visually hidden table for screen readers.

props.name: text
props.description: Text overrides (`labels` is taken by the callout switch).

slots.name: center
slots.type: { total: number; active: { key: string; d: string; lift: string; label: string; value: number; color: string; fraction: number; isOther: boolean; count: number; } | null; selection: { key: string; d: string; lift: string; label: string; value: number; color: string; fraction: number; isOther: boolean; count: number; }[]; }

props.name: orientation
props.description:
`vertical` (default) is the job list: room for descriptions, durations
and folded sub-steps. `horizontal` is the strip across a card or a
header, where the run is read at a glance.

props.name: compact
props.description:
Smaller marks, no descriptions. Horizontal and compact is marks and
lines only, each step named in a tooltip — a run in a table cell.

props.name: numbered
props.description: Number the pending marks, for a run whose order is part of its meaning.

props.name: follow
props.description:
Keep the current step (see `currentStepIndex`) scrolled into view as the
run advances: a long job list, or a horizontal strip wider than its box.

props.name: autoExpand
props.description:
Open a step on its own when it starts running or fails, if it has
something inside, and fold it again when it passes. That is the step the
viewer would open next anyway; a step the viewer opened stays open.

props.name: announce
props.description: Announce status changes to screen readers. A nested pipeline turns it off so its parent speaks once.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Keys of the open steps. Works uncontrolled; bind it to keep it in the app.

slots.name: detail
slots.description: Inside an expanded step, under its sub-steps: a log tail, a link to the run, an error.

props.name: panelClass
props.description: Extra classes for the floating panel (width, padding, overflow).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the panel, which reka exposes as a dialog.

props.name: tone
props.description:
`"auto"` colours by how full the bar is — calm up to `warnAt`, accent
past it, danger past `dangerAt`.

A gauge of a finite resource (disk, memory, quota) means something
different at 92% than at 12%, and consumers were each re-deriving that
with their own palette — which also put raw colours back into components
the theme can no longer reach.

Any of the kit's tone names works (tone.ts): `success`/`warning` read the
same as `action`/`accent`.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: `auto` tone: the fill fraction, 0–1, where the bar turns accent.

props.name: dangerAt
props.description: `auto` tone: the fill fraction, 0–1, where it turns danger.

props.name: title
props.description:
Bar only: a name for what is being measured, printed above the bar. With
`caption` it forms the "CPU … 42%" header a usage row wants.

props.name: caption
props.description:
Bar only: the reading, printed opposite `title`. `true` prints the
rounded percentage; a string says it in the units that matter
("23 GB / 64 GB"), which a percentage alone cannot.

props.name: variant
props.description: `bar` (default) fills horizontally; `ring` draws a dial.

props.name: size
props.description: Ring only: outer diameter in px.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Ring only: stroke width in px.

props.name: label
props.description:
Ring only: print the rounded percentage in the middle. Pass a string to
label it with something else ("12.4k", "3/8") — the ring shows progress,
the caption says what it is progress of.

props.name: animateOnMount
props.description:
Grow from empty on first render instead of appearing already filled.

A dial that arrives complete states a fact; one that fills shows a
quantity being measured, and the eye follows the sweep to where it stops —
which is the number the tile is actually about. Both variants already ease
every later change, so this only concerns the first paint.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the fill takes, in ms. The counter in a ring matches it.

props.name: limit
props.description: Unset, zero or Infinity means unlimited: the reading stays, the bar and "left" go.

props.name: label
props.description: What is counted ("Storage", "Seats"). Also the accessible name.

props.name: unit
props.description: `"bytes"`, a plain suffix ("seats"), or a formatter. See `formatAmount`.

props.name: parts
props.description:
What the used amount is made of. The bar stacks them and a legend names
them; their sum need not equal `used` (a part can be left unlisted), but
the bar shows the parts, so list them all if the bar should add up.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Share of the limit (0–1) where the quota turns warning.

props.name: dangerAt
props.description: Share of the limit where it turns danger. Over the limit is always danger.

props.name: hideLegend
props.description: Hide the legend under a stacked bar, for a compact row where the tooltip of the page says enough.

props.name: animateOnMount
props.description: Fill from empty when first seen.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Selected range, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD" ends (v-model).

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Days that cannot be picked at all.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Days a range may not include (struck through, and a range cannot span them).

props.name: months
props.description: Months shown side by side.

props.name: maximumDays
props.description: Longest allowed range, in days.

props.name: minGap
props.description: The least distance the two ends keep between them, in model units.

props.name: ariaLabels
props.description: Accessible names for the two thumbs when there's no visible label.

props.name: format
props.description: Label over each thumb while it is in use: `(value) => "1:05"`.

props.name: date
props.description: A Date, an ISO string or epoch milliseconds.

props.name: format
props.description: Intl's width: `long` "3 minutes ago", `short` "3 min. ago", `narrow` "3m ago".

props.name: nowWithin
props.description: Within this many ms of now it reads "now" rather than counting seconds.

props.name: tooltip
props.description:
Show the exact date on hover and focus. Off, it moves to the native
`title` instead, for a dense log where tooltips would get in the way of
reading; it is never shown both ways at once, which would stack two
hints on one hover.

props.name: absolute
props.description: How the exact date is written. Defaults to the full date with the time.

props.name: createItem
props.description: Return a fresh item when Add is pressed. Data and validation remain the caller's.

props.name: itemKey
props.description: Stable business key for immutable reloads; omitted, object identity keeps unsaved rows stable.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ add: string; remove: string; empty: string; }> | undefined

slots.name: default
slots.type: { item: T; index: number; disabled: boolean; update: (item: T) => void; remove: () => void; }

props.name: preset
props.description: How the content appears. `rise` suits most blocks; `fade` is the quietest.

props.name: direction
props.description: The way the content travels for `rise` and `blur`: `up` comes from below.

props.name: distance
props.description: Travel distance in px.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait after the block is seen.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds per entrance.

props.name: stagger
props.description:
Milliseconds between consecutive direct children. 0 animates the block
as one piece. The steps stop growing after ten children, so long lists
still finish quickly.

props.name: immediate
props.description: Show at once, without waiting or animating — for content already known to be on screen.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Fraction of the block that must be visible before it plays.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render as.

props.name: value
props.description: The text. A change to this is what triggers the transition.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way "slide" travels. `up` moves the old text up and out.

props.name: align
props.description:
Alignment inside the clipped box, for when the two values differ in
width — a value that grows shouldn't shove its neighbours.

props.name: value
props.description: The value the text settles on.

props.name: trigger
props.description:
What starts a scramble besides a change of `value`:
`reveal` the first time it is on screen (a key below the fold decrypts
when it is scrolled to), `mount` at once, `hover` each time the pointer
comes in (a teaser), `none` only on changes and `play()`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Scramble travel time in ms.

props.name: order
props.description: `sequential` decodes left to right; `together` lands every position at the end.

props.name: glyphs
props.description: Glyph pool to churn through. Defaults to upper case, digits and a few symbols.

props.name: animateChanges
props.description: Scramble when `value` changes. Off: a new value lands at once.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render.

props.name: value
props.description: The secret, for the read-only display.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The secret, for the `input` form (v-model).

props.name: input
props.description: Editable field instead of a display.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Show the copy button. On by default: copying is what a secret is shown for.

props.name: revealable
props.description: Offer the eye button. Off for a value that should only ever be copied, never shown.

props.name: autoHide
props.description:
Seconds after which a revealed value hides itself again. Unset keeps it
shown until the person hides it.

props.name: regenerate
props.description:
Rotates the secret. The button spins while it runs and a failure is
toasted (LpButton's `action`); the new value arrives through `value`.
For a custom action (with a confirm, say) use the `actions` slot.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Let a long value wrap onto more lines instead of staying on one. Display form only.

props.name: maskLength
props.description: How many dots stand for the value while hidden.

props.name: revealed
props.description: Shown or hidden; bind it to drive the reveal from outside.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the title.

props.name: icon
props.description: Iconify name shown before the title, e.g. "lucide:server".

props.name: level
props.description: Visual size. Independent of `as`, see the note above.

props.name: as
props.description: The heading element to render. Pick it for the document outline.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Title markup, when a plain string is not enough.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Description markup, when a plain string is not enough.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Right-aligned controls: buttons, filters, a count.

slots.name: meta
slots.description: Extra content beside the title: a badge, a count, a status dot.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to fill the container with equal-width segments.

props.name: hoverFollow
props.description:
The pill glides under the hovered segment and springs back on leave (the
default, as in LpTabs). False pins it to the selected segment and hover
only tints the label.

props.name: size
props.description: Trigger height, keyed to --size-control-*. Default "md".

props.name: selected
props.description:
What the current value stands for, for when `options` cannot say: with
server-side search the picked option is usually not among the current
results, and a value restored from a saved form arrives before any list
does. For `multiple`, an array matching `modelValue` by position.
Options the user picks in this session are remembered on their own, so
this is only needed for values the field has never listed.

events.name: blur
events.description: Focus left the whole field (not into its own list or clear button).

props.name: intensity
props.description: How strongly the theme colours show over the surface, 0–1. Lower for a backdrop under body text.

props.name: speed
props.description: Motion speed; 1 is a calm drift, 0.5 half as fast.

props.name: fps
props.description: Frame cap. 30 is smooth for slow motion and half the work of 60.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the current frame.

props.name: still
props.description: Always show the CSS still, never start WebGL: for a low-power mode or a screenshot.

props.name: axis
props.description:
Which dimension eases. `"width"` for a row that gains/loses controls,
`"height"` for a stack whose content grows, `"both"` when either can.

props.name: duration
props.description: Tween length in ms. Defaults to the kit's `--duration-fast`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Turn the easing off entirely — the wrapper stays, the box resizes
instantly. For a box that is being driven by something else (a drag, a
canvas), where a tween would fight the thing already animating it.

props.name: variant
props.description: `shine` sweeps a band over toned text; `gradient` paints it with drifting theme colours.

props.name: tone
props.description: Base colour for `shine`. `ink` sweeps the brand colour over plain text.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds per sweep. Slower reads as ambient; under ~1.5 s it starts to nag.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stop the motion (keeps the look). For a word that should only shine while something is happening.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render.

props.name: live
props.description: Also list the bindings mounted right now (`useHotkeys` with `help`).

props.name: glass
props.description: Frosted glass panel, passed to LpModal. Follows `provideGlass` when unset.

props.name: hotkey
props.description:
A key that toggles the reference, e.g. "F1". Bound only while the dialog
is mounted, also inside inputs and over other overlays, and the browser's
own use of the key (Chrome opens its help page on F1) is suppressed.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Active item id (v-model). Ignored when `isActive` is provided.

props.name: items
props.description: Flat items, or sections for grouped nav.

props.name: isActive
props.description:
Custom active test — for router-driven nav where "active" is a path-prefix
match (e.g. /billing vs /billing-details), not a simple id compare. When
given it overrides the modelValue check. The consumer owns the routing.

props.name: searchable
props.description:
Put a filter field above the nav. A hundred-item sidebar is not read, it
is searched: past a screenful, scanning costs more than typing, and every
app that has one had built the same LpInput into the #header slot.

Filtering is on `label` (and any `keywords` on the item), case- and
accent-insensitive. Sections whose items all fail drop out rather than
leaving a run of empty headings, and a collapsed section opens while a
query is active — a hidden match is the same as no match.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for that field (defaults to the `search` label).

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ nav: string; search: string; }> | undefined
props.description: Text overrides: `nav` names the landmark, `search` the filter field.

props.name: search
props.description: The query, when the app wants to own it (v-model:search).

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a skeleton placeholder instead of the items.

props.name: skeletonRows
props.description: Skeleton row count while loading.

props.name: skeletonHeader
props.description: Render the user/header skeleton row too (paired with a #header avatar).

props.name: responsive
props.description:
Collapse to a swipeable drawer on phones. Off by default so existing
static-rail usage is unchanged.

props.name: open
props.description: Drawer open state on mobile (v-model:open). Only used when `responsive`.

props.name: mobileBreakpoint
props.description: Tailwind breakpoint below which the drawer takes over.

props.name: edgeOpen
props.description: Let a pull from the left screen edge drag the mobile drawer open.

props.name: divider
props.description:
Draw a hairline rule between the #header (logo) and the nav. On by
default — it visually anchors the brand above the items. Pass false for a
flush, header-less look.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Where this nav lives.

`rail` is the app shell's edge: one hairline on the inner side, square
corners, the raised shell background.

`panel` is a nav that sits inside a page next to the content it drives —
a settings index, a table picker. It is a card: boxed on all four sides
and rounded. Without it the rail's single border reads as a stray line
down the middle of the page, and a consumer cannot cancel it with a class
of their own.

props.name: width
props.description:
Rail width. A plain `class` cannot set it — the component's own `w-60`
wins, and the kit does not merge conflicting Tailwind classes — so the
width is a prop. Any CSS length; a page-embedded nav usually wants to
match the column it lives in.

props.name: collapsed
props.description:
Which collapsible groups are folded away (v-model:collapsed). Leave it
unbound to let the sidebar fold long navs on its own — see
`autoCollapseAfter`.

props.name: persist
props.description:
Remember which groups the user folded, across visits, under this key
(the kit's storage, see `usePersisted`). Without it, and without
v-model:collapsed, the choice lasts for the session.

props.name: autoCollapseAfter
props.description:
Fold collapsible groups automatically once the nav has more than this
many rows, counting headings and items alike.

The reason is the reader, not the pixels: a short nav is taken in at a
glance, a long one has to be searched, and searching a list you did not
choose to have is the part that grates. Past the threshold the groups
that are not today's work fold themselves, and the one holding the
current page always stays open.

0 turns it off — the app then owns the state through `collapsed`.

props.name: hoverFollow
props.description:
The active pill follows the hovered item, as in LpTabs. Off by default;
see LpSidebarNav for why a tall nav keeps it pinned.

props.name: groups
props.description: Normalised section list (LpSidebar collapses items/sections into this).

props.name: pillId
props.description: Shared layoutId so the active pill flies between desktop/drawer renders.

props.name: collapsedKeys
props.description:
Keys of the groups currently folded away. The owner holds this so the
choice can outlive the component (a setting, a stored preference) — the
nav itself only reports the intent to change it.

props.name: hoverFollow
props.description:
The active pill glides under the hovered item and springs back on leave,
as in LpTabs and LpTableOfContents. Off by default here, unlike those:
a sidebar is tall and the pointer crosses it on the way to the page
beside it, so a pill chasing every pass would flicker through a dozen
rows and hide the one thing a nav must keep in view, where you are. A
short rail (an app switcher, a settings list) can turn it on.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the thumb when there's no visible label.

props.name: data
props.description: Oldest → newest. `null` breaks the line, as in LpChart.

props.name: width
props.description: Rendered size in px. The path scales to it; stroke width does not.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour. Defaults to the brand token.

props.name: tone
props.description: Named theme tones, for callers that don't want to spell a var().

props.name: area
props.description: Fill under the line.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Curve tension, as in LpChart. 0 draws a polyline.

props.name: showLast
props.description: Dot on the final point — "you are here" on a trend.

props.name: min
props.description:
Pin the vertical range instead of fitting the data. Without it a flat
series fills the box with noise, and two sparklines in one column can't
be compared: each would be scaled to its own extremes.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible description; falls back to a direction + latest value.

props.name: animate
props.description:
Draw the line on from oldest to newest when it first appears. Turn it off
for a table that renders many at once — dozens of simultaneous sweeps
read as flicker.

props.name: duration
props.description:
Draw time in ms. The stroke travels at a near-even rate (see
`--ease-travel`), so this is roughly how long the line is actually
watched being drawn — not a figure mostly spent easing out.

props.name: loading
props.description:
The series is on its way: a pulsing band the size of the line's own box
stands in, so a cell or a stat tile does not change size when the trend
arrives, and the line then draws itself in as usual.

props.name: sample
props.description:
Inside a `v-hint` element with no values, a tour step on that hint draws
a made-up trend here (no tag: it would not fit inline; the tour card
says it is an example). Off: the flat stub shows on the tour too.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour. Defaults to the brand colour, so it follows the theme.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the lit circle, in px. Larger reads as ambient, smaller as a torch.

props.name: strength
props.description: How much of the colour mixes in, 0–100. Keep it low on text-heavy surfaces.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Keep the wrapper but draw nothing — for a tile that is disabled or busy.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render as.

props.name: value
props.description:
A string is printed as given; a NUMBER counts to its new value on
LpNumberFlow's digit wheels. A tile on a live dashboard is the one place
a figure changes while somebody is looking at it, and a value that cuts
from 41 to 43 says nothing about which way it moved.

props.name: compact
props.description: Formatting for a numeric `value` — see LpNumberFlow.

props.name: delta
props.description:
Change vs. a previous period. Renders a coloured arrow + this text. A
number is shown with a sign; a string is shown verbatim (e.g. "+12%").

props.name: deltaSuffix
props.description: Appended to a numeric delta, e.g. "%". Ignored for string deltas.

props.name: trend
props.description: Trend direction. "auto" derives it from a numeric delta's sign.

props.name: invertTrend
props.description:
For metrics where down is good (latency, errors): swaps the colours so a
downward trend reads as positive (action) and upward as danger.

props.name: loading
props.description:
The figure is still on its way. The tile keeps its shape and every line
its height: the value and the delta pulse as blocks set in their own type
size, so the tile is exactly as tall loading as loaded and the row of
tiles does not move when the numbers land. A known label stays readable
(it names the tile, it is not data); an empty one pulses too.

props.name: label
props.description: The word shown, when the state's own name is not the right one ("Ready", "In a match").

props.name: tone
props.description: Overrides the state's tone, for an app whose "offline" is an alarm rather than a rest state.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Overrides whether the light pulses.

props.name: variant
hideLabel
props.description:
Light only. The word is still there for screen readers and as a native
hint on hover, so a dense list can drop it visually without going silent.

props.name: announce
props.description:
Speak changes as they happen (`role="status"`). Off by default: a table
of twenty servers announcing each flip would drown everything else.
Turn it on for the one status the user is waiting on.

props.name: variant
props.description: `status` (default) colours a job's outcome; `step` is a wizard's step (see above).

props.name: number
props.description: Shown inside a pending mark: the step's number in a numbered flow.

props.name: icon
props.description: Shown inside a pending mark instead of the number.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; without it the mark is hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: current
props.description: The active step: an index, or a step `key` for keyed flows.

props.name: completed
props.description:
Which steps count as done. Omit it and everything before `current` is
complete, which is the linear case. Pass keys (or indices) when a flow can
finish steps out of order — a verification that succeeds before its
prerequisite is filled in, say.

props.name: swapKey
props.description: Identity of the current content; a new value plays the swap.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turn the motion off (the content still swaps).

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary line under the label.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description:
Where the text sits. `end` (default) reads like LpCheckbox: switch, then
text. `start` is the settings-row shape: text on the left, the switch
pushed to the right edge of the row.

props.name: action
props.description:
Saves the new state. The switch flips at once and shows a spinner in its
thumb while this runs; if it fails, the switch flips back and the error
becomes a toast (or the `error` event, when the app listens). A setting
stored on a server needs no busy flag or rollback of its own.

props.name: rows
props.description: The rows, for a table that holds its data. Ignored when `load` is set.

props.name: load
props.type: ((query: TableQuery, signal: AbortSignal) => TablePage<T> | Promise<TablePage<T>>) | undefined
props.description:
Fetch the rows instead of being handed them: paging, sorting and the
header filters then happen on the server. Debounced and abortable, the
same way as the command palette's `search` — a stale page never lands
over a fresher one.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page with `load`.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Wait after a sort or filter change before `load` runs.

props.name: loading
props.description:
The rows are on their way, for a table handed `rows` by a parent that
fetches them itself (with `load` the table knows on its own). An empty
table shows skeleton rows in the shape of its columns; a filled one dims
while the next rows come.

props.name: skeletonRows
props.description: How many skeleton rows stand in for the first page.

props.name: rowKey
props.description:
Stable id per row. Without it a row is keyed by its position in `rows`,
which survives sorting and filtering but not a new array; set it whenever
rows are replaced (`load`, polling) and selection must carry over.

props.name: selectable
props.description:
Rows can be selected (v-model:selected). `true` shows a tick column,
where pressing a tick and sweeping ticks the run. `"hold"` keeps the
column out of sight until it is needed: a long press on a row selects it
(and the same press goes on selecting the rows it is dragged across), the
column slides in, and while anything is selected a click on a row toggles
it. Emptying the selection, or Escape, slides the column away again.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected row keys (v-model:selected).

props.name: sort
props.description:
Active sort (v-model:sort). When set, the parent owns ordering (server
side); otherwise the table sorts its own rows client-side.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Pin the header while the body scrolls. Pair with a height on the wrapper.

props.name: rowMenu
props.description:
Per-row right-click menu. Return [] (or omit the prop) to disable it for
a row; the row then keeps the browser's native context menu. Return
`{ title, subtitle?, image?, icon?, items }` to head the menu with the
row's name, so it is clear which row the right-click hit.

props.name: sortAscLabel
props.description:
Wording for the header's right-click menu. Passed in because the kit
carries no translations: an app that leaves these alone gets English.

props.name: filterLabel
props.description: Wording for the value filter and the column chooser.

props.name: exportable
props.description: Offer a CSV download in a toolbar above the table and in its menu.

props.name: exportFilename
props.description: File name for that download, without extension.

props.name: labels
props.description: All of the wording above in one object, and the config-level scope "table".

props.name: density
props.description: Row height: `compact` for dense data, `comfortable` (default) otherwise.

props.name: summary
props.description:
Always show the bar above the table with the row count. It shows on its
own while filters are active or rows are selected.

props.name: persist
props.description:
Remember sort, value filters and hidden columns across visits under this
key (the kit's storage, see `usePersisted`). Only plain filter values (text, numbers) are kept.

props.name: allMatching
props.description:
With `load`: the user chose "select all N" beyond the loaded page
(v-model:allMatching). The keys in `selected` are then only the loaded
ones; acting on everything that matches is the consumer's to do.

slots.name: bulk
slots.type: { selected: RowKey[]; allMatching: boolean; clear: () => void; }

props.name: title
props.description: Heading shown above the list (defaults to the `title` label).

props.name: offset
props.description:
The least distance, px from the top, of the scroll-spy trigger line. The
line sits at a quarter of the view when that is lower: a heading a
couple of lines down already starts what is being read, and a fixed line
near the top kept the previous section lit under it.

props.name: hoverFollow
props.description:
The bar glides under the hovered link and springs back on leave (the
default), as in LpTabs. False pins it to the section in view: calmer for
a rail beside the text, which the pointer crosses on its way to scroll.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially active tab when `v-model` is not bound (default: the first).

props.name: variant
props.description:
"contained" (default) wraps the triggers in a bordered, filled bar.
"plain" drops the container chrome — a flat row of tabs with only the
sliding pill marking the active one (for nav bars over a custom surface).
"underline" is a flat row over a hairline baseline, marking the active
tab with a sliding bottom bar instead of a pill (page-section nav style).
"bottom" is a phone's bottom navigation: full width, equal-share tabs
with the icon over the label, a sliding bar along the top edge marking
the active one, and padding for the gesture strip and side insets of an
edge-to-edge screen. Place it as the last row of the layout.

props.name: accent
props.description: Tint the active pill + label with the brand colour (nav-bar style).

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch the bar to full width with equal-share triggers.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the tab list, e.g. "Main" for an app's navigation.

props.name: hoverFollow
props.description:
The marker glides under the hovered tab and springs back on leave (the
default). False pins it to the selected tab: calmer for a dense header
where the pointer crosses the bar on its way elsewhere.

props.name: delimiter
props.description: Characters (or a RegExp) that end a tag while typing and split a paste.

props.name: max
props.description: At most this many tags.

props.name: duplicates
props.description:
"reject" keeps a repeat typed with a note, "ignore" drops it with a passing
note, "allow" keeps it. Either way the tag it repeats pulses.

props.name: validate
props.description: Return an error message to refuse a tag.

props.name: normalize
props.description: Applied to each tag before it is checked and stored (trim is always applied).

props.name: addOnBlur
props.description: Turn leftover text into a tag when the field loses focus.

props.name: display
props.description:
What a tag stands for: return a name (with an optional muted hint and
picture) to draw the tag as a person or a server rather than its raw
value, or null to show the value as typed. The model keeps the values.

props.name: options
props.description:
Suggestions offered while typing; picking one adds its `value`. Typed
text that matches none still becomes a tag as before. Already-added
values are left out of the list.

props.name: loading
props.description: Suggestions are being fetched (listen to `search` to fetch them).

props.name: filter
props.description: Filter `options` against the typed text here. Off when the parent narrows them itself.

props.name: size
props.description: Box height and text size, as LpInput.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. A change animates only the words that changed.

props.name: by
props.description: The unit that animates. Letters suit a short heading; words read better on a sentence.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between pieces in ms. Defaults to 70 for words, 22 for letters.

props.name: duration
props.description: Each piece's entrance in ms.

props.name: rise
props.description: How far a piece rises, in px. 0 for a pure fade.

props.name: blur
props.description: Start out of focus and sharpen. Off for long text on a slow machine, where a blur per piece costs frames.

props.name: play
props.description:
Hold the text hidden until true. Leave unset to play the first time the
text is on screen.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Changing this plays the whole text again (the old one fades out first).

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render: `h1`…`h6` or `p` for a heading or a paragraph.

props.name: required
props.description:
Marks the label with the required indicator; the attribute still reaches
the <textarea> for native validation.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element. A wrapper that should not affect layout can use `class="contents"`.

props.name: transition
props.description: Reveal a change of `theme` with the circular transition.

props.name: studio
props.description: A studio from useThemeStudio; by default the shared one for `storageKey`.

props.name: themes
props.description: Base themes, when the panel makes its own studio.

props.name: brands
props.description: Brand swatches offered beside the free colour picker.

props.name: hide
props.description: Built-in rows to leave out.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Active theme NAME (v-model). Falls back to the first theme.

props.name: themes
props.description: Themes to offer. Defaults to all built-in presets.

props.name: cycleThemes
props.description:
Themes the LEFT-click cycles through — names from `themes`, or TokenSets.
Defaults to the full list (cycle everything). Pass two, e.g.
`:cycle-themes="['Dark', 'Light']"`, for a quick dark/light toggle while
the right-click menu still offers every theme.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Trigger style:
 - "swatch" (default): a round chip previewing the theme's surface and brand.
 - "icon": a sun/moon icon following the active theme's mode.
 - "pill": the chip and the theme name in a rounded pill.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the active theme's name next to the trigger (forced on for "pill").

props.name: default
props.description:
Default theme applied on mount when nothing is cached yet — the theme NAME
(must be in `themes`) or a TokenSet. Lets a consuming app pick its default
declaratively (<LpThemeSwitcher :default="'Violet'">) with no separate
bootstrap plugin; a previously saved choice still wins over it.

props.name: transition
props.description: Animate theme changes with the circular reveal. On by default.

props.name: system
props.type: { light: string | TokenSet; dark: string | TokenSet; } | undefined
props.description:
Offer a "System" entry in the menu that follows the OS colour scheme,
switching between these two themes (names from `themes`, or TokenSets).

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ trigger: string; system: string; studio: string; openStudio: string; }> | undefined
props.description: Text overrides. `trigger` may contain `{name}`.

props.name: studio
props.description:
The right-click menu ends with "Theme studio…", set apart from the
themes, which opens LpThemeStudio by the trigger: the theme plus brand
colour, corners, control size and motion, remembered under `studioKey`.
Picks and left-click cycling go through the studio then, so a tuned
brand or corner survives the next theme. Rows of the app's own go in
the `#studio-start` / `#studio-end` slots, built-in ones leave with
`studioHide`.

props.name: max
props.description: Max rotation toward the pointer, in degrees.

props.name: lift
props.description: Upward lift on hover, in px.

props.name: scale
props.description: Scale on hover.

props.name: glare
props.description: Render a pointer-tracking glare highlight over the content.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective depth for the 3D stage, in px. Lower = stronger.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Selected time "HH:mm" (v-model).

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: 24 or 12-hour clock, independent of the browser locale.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for segment order and the AM/PM marker in 12-hour mode.

props.name: icon
props.description: Show the clock icon at the start of the field.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ dismiss: string; copy: string; copied: string; }> | undefined

props.name: side
props.description: Which edge to prefer; flips automatically when there is no room.

props.name: label
props.description:
The tip names the control rather than describing it — for a trigger with
no visible text of its own. Sets the accessible name instead of only
adding a description.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before the tip appears on hover. Unset follows the provider, else 200.

props.name: showOnPointerFocus
props.description:
Show on any focus, not just keyboard focus. Off by default: a tip that
pops up after every mouse click on the trigger is noise.

props.name: followCursor
props.description:
Track the pointer instead of anchoring to the trigger's edge.

For a trigger that is large or oddly shaped — a chart slice, a canvas, a
map region — where the element's bounding box says little about what the
pointer is actually over: anchored to the box, the tip can appear far from
the thing it describes. Following the cursor keeps it next to the reading.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Suppress the tip. For a trigger whose tip only applies to part of it — a
chart wrapper where the pointer may be over a mark or over empty canvas —
so an empty panel never opens over the gaps.

This also FORCES CLOSED a tip that is already showing. reka's own
`disabled` does not: it stops managing the tooltip where it stands, so one
that was open when the flag flipped stayed on screen for good — outliving
the pointer, letting a second chart open its own beside it, and surviving
a scroll that should have dismissed it.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before the first tip appears on hover.

props.name: skipDelay
props.description: How long after a tip closes the next one still opens at once.

props.name: connectable
props.description: Allow drag-to-connect (emits `connect`). Default false (read-only).

props.name: selectable
props.description:
Desktop-style marquee selection: drag on empty canvas to rubber-band a
box and select every node inside; the selected set then drags together.
Hold Shift to add to the selection. Panning moves to a right-drag / the
space bar so left-drag is free for selecting. Default false (left-drag
pans, the classic read-only behaviour). Emits `selection-change`.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the edge-type legend (Network / Depends-on / Pending / Drift).

props.name: legendPosition
props.description:
Where the legend sits. Defaults to bottom-left: hosts commonly float a
toolbar across the top, which would cover a top-anchored legend, and the
minimap owns the bottom-right.

props.name: edgeType
props.description:
Edge shape. The default bezier bulges away from the straight line between
its ends, which suits a free-form graph and cuts through everything in a
LAYERED one — a long edge crosses the cards standing between its columns.
`smoothstep` routes orthogonally through the gaps instead.

props.name: legendLabels
props.description: Rename legend rows to match what this graph's edges actually mean.

props.name: lanes
props.description:
Background swimlanes drawn beneath the nodes (one per project / overlay).
Non-interactive; pan/zoom with the graph. Empty = no lanes.

props.name: minimap
props.description:
Minimap and zoom controls. On by default — a full-page map needs both —
but a graph embedded at a few hundred pixels has nothing to navigate, and
the overlays then cover a real share of the picture.

props.name: startDelay
props.description: Ms before the first keystroke, once it is on screen.

props.name: as

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Caption shown under the left edge (oldest point).

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Caption shown under the right edge (newest point).

props.name: showUptime
props.description: Show the computed uptime % above the bar.

props.name: title
props.description: Override the headline shown next to the uptime %.

props.name: colors
props.description:
Per-status colours. Any CSS colour (hex, rgb, `var(--token)`). Unset
statuses fall back to the theme tokens below. Pass e.g.
`{ degraded: '#ffb84d' }` to recolour just one state.

props.name: labels
props.description: Status names, for the tooltip and screen readers.

props.name: loading
props.description:
The history is on its way. The row of ticks pulses in place of the
slices (as many as `segments` already holds, else `skeletonSlices`) at
the bar's own height, and the uptime figure waits as a block; the
captions stay, so nothing around the bar moves when the data lands.

props.name: skeletonSlices
props.description: Ticks drawn while loading with no segments yet.

props.name: poster
props.description: Shown until the first frame decodes, and instead of motion when it is unwanted.

props.name: start
props.description: Where the looped stretch begins, in seconds.

props.name: end
props.description: Where it ends, in seconds; the clip's end when unset.

props.name: crossfade
props.description: Seconds of media over which the next pass fades in at the seam; 0 cuts straight back.

props.name: rate
props.description: Playback rate: 0.5 is half speed.

props.name: dim
props.description: A dark veil over the picture, 0 to 1, for text laid on top.

props.name: playWithReducedMotion
props.description: Keep playing when the system asks for reduced motion (it shows a still otherwise).

props.name: easePlayback
props.description: Milliseconds over which a pause slows the picture to a halt and a resume brings it back up; 0 stops dead.
